name: Amplitude
label: Amplitude — HTTP V2 ingest + export/taxonomy
description: Official Amplitude HTTP V2 (POST https://api2.amplitude.com/2/httpapi) plus Identify, Group Identify, Batch, Export API v2, and Taxonomy. Handler: OfficialApiNode. US ingest host api2.amplitude.com; Export/Taxonomy per-op baseUrl https://amplitude.com (GET /api/2/export, GET /api/2/taxonomy/event) with extraHeaders Authorization: Basic {basic_token} (precomputed Base64 of api_key:secret_key). Ingest sends api_key in the JSON or form body and as the query api_key. Identify posts identification as a JSON array. Customer owns the Amplitude project. Keys are never logged. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Set operation to override config.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT catalog verb.

schema.label: events
schema.description: Array of Amplitude event objects (event_type + user_id and/or device_id). HTTP V2: keep under 1 MB and prefer ≤10 events.

schema.label: start
schema.description: Export first hour YYYYMMDDTHH (UTC upload time).

schema.label: end
schema.description: Export last hour YYYYMMDDTHH; max span 365 days.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (provider JSON). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON body. Minimize retained PII.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: event.track | identify | group.identify | event.batch | export.download | taxonomy.list.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: Project API key (query api_key). Never log.

configurationParameters.label: Server Zone
configurationParameters.description: Project residency. Packaged baseUrl is US api2.amplitude.com. EU ingest is api.eu.amplitude.com; EU analytics is analytics.eu.amplitude.com.

configurationParameters.label: Export Basic token
configurationParameters.description: Base64(api_key:secret_key) for Export/Taxonomy HTTP Basic. Precompute locally; extraHeaders send Authorization: Basic {basic_token} on those ops only (ingest still uses query api_key). Never log. https://amplitude.com/docs/apis/analytics/export

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 25. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.
